input_text:
CONTRACT CONTEXT:
A copy of any such agreement shall be available for inspection upon request by the KDOL and will not be subject to disclosure to third parties by anyone other than KDOL. 

TARGET STATEMENT:
The contract entails that the relevant party must keep confidential the existence, terms, subject matter, or status of the agreement, negotiations, discussions, or transaction between the parties.

DECISION TASK:
Determine whether the contract context entails the target statement.

The contract entails that the relevant party must keep confidential the existence, terms, subject matter, or status of the agreement, negotiations, discussions, or transaction between the parties.

claim.text: Does the CONTRACT CONTEXT logically entail the EXACT TARGET STATEMENT, with every material element matched and no missing limitation, exception, party-scope mismatch, information-type mismatch, purpose limitation, recipient-scope mismatch, or disclosure carve-out?

arguments.text: The contract context explicitly limits the non-disclosure obligation to third parties and carves out an exception for KDOL, which narrows the scope of confidentiality compared to the target statement's broad requirement.
arguments.legal_rule: Contract interpretation requires matching scope; explicit exceptions narrow obligations.
arguments.evidence_span: will not be subject to disclosure to third parties by anyone other than KDOL.

arguments.text: The target statement requires confidentiality over existence, terms, subject matter, or status of the agreement, negotiations, discussions, or transaction, but the contract context only addresses the agreement itself, lacking explicit coverage for negotiations or discussions.
arguments.legal_rule: Entailment requires explicit or necessarily implied coverage of all material elements in the target.
arguments.evidence_span: A copy of any such agreement shall be available for inspection upon request by the KDOL

arguments.text: The contract context permits disclosure to KDOL upon request, which directly contradicts a strict confidentiality obligation that would prohibit disclosure to any unauthorized party or require keeping the agreement's existence or terms confidential from all third parties.
arguments.legal_rule: Permitted disclosures carve out confidentiality obligations.
arguments.evidence_span: available for inspection upon request by the KDOL

arguments.text: The contract context lacks an explicit confidentiality clause that establishes a general duty to keep the agreement's terms or status confidential, relying instead on a specific non-disclosure provision limited to third parties.
arguments.legal_rule: Absence of a broad confidentiality clause attacks entailment of a broad confidentiality claim.
arguments.evidence_span: A copy of any such agreement shall be available for inspection upon request by the KDOL and will not be subject to disclosure to third parties by anyone other than KDOL.
